description: This source file defines the CrossSubdomainSessionValve class, which extends ValveBase and is responsible for manipulating session cookies to enable cross-subdomain session sharing in a Tomcat/Tomcat-like environment within the Apache OFBiz framework. It intercepts HTTP requests to replace session cookies with ones bound to a broader domain, facilitating cross-subdomain session continuity.

classes.name: CrossSubdomainSessionValve
classes.description: A custom Tomcat valve that modifies session cookies to enable cross-subdomain session sharing by replacing existing cookies with ones set for a broader domain.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main method that gets called for each request; it initializes the session and replaces session cookies for cross-subdomain support.

methods.name: replaceCookie
methods.description: Helper method that creates a new session cookie with a domain suitable for cross-subdomain use and replaces the original cookie's header in the response.
